decisions.statement: The gap rows a landing draws from are the rows the landing before it filed.
A landing works out again the gap rows of the pages its change names, and no others.
The filed rows are read from the working tree, because no commit holds them.
A file with no row yet is filled by reading every page once.
The rows are filed in path order, then in the order the page says them.
A page stating no gap holds no row, so a page is read by the gaps it states.

definition: the per-page gap rows the gaps picture is drawn from, kept beside the picture
